description: Submit a structured deliverable for deterministic schema validation, quarantine and lossless compaction. Verified deposits emit a signed Clean-Room Receipt. The receipt.signature field is an hmac-sha256:<base64url> HMAC over the canonical JSON of every receipt field except signature; verify an unchanged receipt at POST /api/verify_receipt.

deposit_ticket.description: Signed rc_dep_... ticket issued by open_suite.

payload.description: Structured deliverable JSON matching the suite's output_schema.

worker_id.description: Optional worker identifier for council suites. Reuse the same deposit ticket for each deposit until the suite is VERIFIED, CLAIMED, EXPIRED, or out of attempts. IDs need not be unique; claimed council deposits are ordered by worker_id, then arrival.

name: deposit_deliverable

receipt.description: Present only for verified deposits. Signature covers the canonical unsigned receipt.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical compacted payload.

signature.description: hmac-sha256:<base64url> HMAC-SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of all receipt fields except signature. Verify with POST /api/verify_receipt.
